entries.en: The deadline is getting closer.[n]Can we go to the Palace?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I'm ready whenever, so let me[n]know if you're going.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I'll make my way to the hideout.
